DB pool = reusable set of open DB connections.

Without pool:
- App opens DB conn per req
- Auth/handshake/TLS/setup cost each time
- Many reqs -> many conns -> DB overloaded

With pool:
- App starts N conns
- Req borrows conn
- Runs query
- Returns conn to pool
- Next req reuses same conn

Why helps:
- Faster: skip conn setup
- Safer: caps max DB conns
- Better load handling: reqs wait instead of crashing DB
- Less CPU/network overhead
- More predictable latency

Key tuning:
- Pool too small -> queue slow
- Pool too big -> DB saturation
- Set timeouts, max lifetime, idle limit
